description:
Want to manage your AI coding sessions without leaving your flow? In this video, we show you how the Logitech MX Keypad integrates with the GitHub Copilot app.  

Learn how to install the plugin, start chats and voice prompts with a single press, track projects and sessions in real time, toggle MCP servers, and customize keys with macros or the Logi Actions SDK. 

Every MX keypad includes three free months of GitHub Copilot Pro+ for new and existing users.  

#GitHubCopilot #Logitech #GitHub 

— CHAPTERS — 

00:00 Introducing the Logitech MX keypad for GitHub Copilot 
00:11 Installing the GitHub Copilot plugin 
00:26 Starting chats and voice prompting from the keypad 
00:45 Projects, sessions, and real-time status 
01:25 Managing MCP servers and app-aware layouts 
01:47 Customizing keys, macros, and the Logi Actions SDK

description:
From the outside, merging stacked pull requests might sound simple: just link related PRs together and merge them in sequence. In this clip, they talk about the hidden complexity behind updating core GitHub systems to make stacked PRs a native, first-class feature. Hear why shipping this feature required rethinking legacy merge architectures.
